data.name: Tooltip_AimAssist
data.value: Turn aim assist on or off. You must load a model first.

data.name: Tooltip_ConstantAITracking
data.value: Always track targets without holding a key. When off, you must hold the aim keybind.

data.name: Tooltip_StickyAim
data.value: Lock onto a target until it moves out of range instead of switching targets.

data.name: Tooltip_StickyAimThreshold
data.value: How far a target must move before switching to a new one. Higher = stays locked longer.

data.name: Tooltip_AimKeybind
data.value: The key you hold to activate aim assist.

data.name: Tooltip_SecondAimKeybind
data.value: An alternate key to activate aim assist.

data.name: Tooltip_MouseMovementMethod
data.value: How mouse movements are sent. Try different options if aim assist isn't working.

data.name: Tooltip_MovementPath
data.value: The curve style used when moving to a target. Affects how natural the movement looks.

data.name: Tooltip_DetectionAreaType
data.value: How targets are prioritized. Center screen is best for most games.

data.name: Tooltip_AimingBoundaries
data.value: Where to aim on the detected target box. Center is usually best.

data.name: Tooltip_MouseSensitivity
data.value: How fast the aim moves. Lower = faster and snappier, higher = slower and smoother.

data.name: Tooltip_MouseJitter
data.value: Adds random small movements to make aim look more human-like.

data.name: Tooltip_XAxisPercent
data.value: Enable the X Offset (%) slider to adjust aim horizontally by percentage.

data.name: Tooltip_YAxisPercent
data.value: Enable the Y Offset (%) slider to adjust aim vertically by percentage.

data.name: Tooltip_YOffset
data.value: Move aim point up (negative) or down (positive) in pixels.

data.name: Tooltip_YOffsetPercent
data.value: Move aim point up or down as a percentage of the target box height.

data.name: Tooltip_XOffset
data.value: Move aim point left (negative) or right (positive) in pixels.

data.name: Tooltip_XOffsetPercent
data.value: Move aim point left or right as a percentage of the target box width.

data.name: Tooltip_PredictionsToggle
data.value: Predict where a moving target will be. Helps track fast-moving targets.

data.name: Tooltip_PredictionMethod
data.value: The algorithm used to predict target movement. Try different ones to see what works best.

data.name: Tooltip_KalmanLeadTime
data.value: How far ahead to predict target position. Higher = more prediction, may overshoot.

data.name: Tooltip_WiseTheFoxLeadTime
data.value: How far ahead to predict target position. Higher = more prediction, may overshoot.

data.name: Tooltip_ShalloeLeadMultiplier
data.value: How many frames ahead to predict. Higher = more prediction, may overshoot.

data.name: Tooltip_EMASmoothingToggle
data.value: Smooth out aim movements to reduce jitter and make tracking steadier.

data.name: Tooltip_EMASmoothing
data.value: How much smoothing to apply. Lower = smoother but slower, higher = faster but jittery.

data.name: Tooltip_AutoTrigger
data.value: Automatically click when a target is detected in your crosshair area.

data.name: Tooltip_CursorCheck
data.value: Only trigger when cursor is directly on target. More accurate but may miss some shots.

data.name: Tooltip_SprayMode
data.value: Hold down fire instead of single clicks. Good for automatic weapons.

data.name: Tooltip_AutoTriggerDelay
data.value: Wait time before firing after detecting a target. Helps avoid accidental shots.

data.name: Tooltip_FOVToggle
data.value: Show a circle on screen indicating the detection area.

data.name: Tooltip_DynamicFOV
data.value: Change FOV size when holding a key. Useful for scoping in.

data.name: Tooltip_ThirdPerson
data.value: Adjust FOV position for third-person camera games.

data.name: Tooltip_DynamicFOVKeybind
data.value: The key to hold for switching to the dynamic FOV size.

data.name: Tooltip_FOVStyle
data.value: Shape of the FOV overlay. Circle is most common.

data.name: Tooltip_FOVSize
data.value: Size of the detection area. Smaller = more precise, larger = wider coverage.

data.name: Tooltip_DynamicFOVSize
data.value: FOV size when holding the Dynamic FOV key. Usually smaller for scoped aim.

data.name: Tooltip_ShowDetectedPlayer
data.value: Draw a box around detected targets on screen.

data.name: Tooltip_ShowAIConfidence
data.value: Display how confident the AI is about each detection (0-100%).

data.name: Tooltip_ShowTracers
data.value: Draw lines from screen edge to detected targets.

data.name: Tooltip_TracerPosition
data.value: Where tracer lines start from on the screen.

data.name: Tooltip_AIConfidenceFontSize
data.value: Text size for the confidence percentage display.

data.name: Tooltip_CornerRadius
data.value: How rounded the detection box corners are. 0 = sharp corners.

data.name: Tooltip_BorderThickness
data.value: How thick the detection box outline is.

data.name: Tooltip_Opacity
data.value: How see-through the detection box is. 0 = invisible, 1 = solid.

data.name: Tooltip_ImageSize
data.value: Resolution the AI uses for detection. Smaller = faster but less accurate.

data.name: Tooltip_TargetClass
data.value: Which type of target to aim at. Best Confidence picks the most certain detection.

data.name: Tooltip_AIMinimumConfidence
data.value: How sure the AI must be before targeting. Higher = fewer false detections but may miss targets.

data.name: Tooltip_EnableModelSwitch
data.value: Allow switching between AI models using a hotkey.

data.name: Tooltip_ModelSwitchKeybind
data.value: Press this key to cycle through available AI models.

data.name: Tooltip_EmergencyStopKeybind
data.value: Press this key to immediately stop all aim assist functions.

data.name: Tooltip_CollectData
data.value: Save screenshots of detections for training new AI models.

data.name: Tooltip_AutoLabelData
data.value: Automatically label collected screenshots with detection data.

data.name: Tooltip_MouseBgEffect
data.value: Show a visual effect on the UI when moving your mouse.

data.name: Tooltip_UITopMost
data.value: Keep this window above all other windows.

data.name: Tooltip_DebugMode
data.value: Show extra information useful for troubleshooting problems.

data.name: Tooltip_SaveConfig
data.value: Save your current settings to a file you can load later.

data.name: Tooltip_ScreenCaptureMethod
data.value: How the screen is captured. DirectX is faster, GDI+ works on more systems.

data.name: Tooltip_StreamGuard
data.value: Hide the overlay from screen recordings and streams. - Appears in system tray.

data.name: Tooltip_RefreshDisplays
data.value: Update the list of available monitors.
